RBA perceived to be 'choosing recession' amid sticky inflation from energy shock (56)
Iron ore in structural decline – 'drowning, not waving' – pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG (53, 71)
Aussie business conditions weakest since pandemic; home buyer sentiment collapses (55, 63)
WA gold rush: multiple high-grade hits and drill-out funding (45, 46, 47, 48)
Data centre energy demand threatens NSW power supply and energy transition (37, 51, 52)
Private credit stress from Bathla collapse ripples through credit markets (3)
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment holds (4)
China-Trump trade tensions escalate, adding global risk premium (59)

sectors.trend: Iron ore in sustained downtrend; copper and gold provide partial offset. WA gold juniors active with high-grade discoveries and funding rounds.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX, WES.AX) and copper (STO.AX) offer relative strength. WA juniors (AUR.AX, GDR.AX, FRT.AX, GWP.AX) attract speculative flows.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on rate-hike fears and credit stress. Private credit market shaken by Bathla collapse. Qantas $35m payout signals corporate stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from rising funding costs and NIM compression risk. Private credit exposure a hidden risk. Insurance sector hit by auto-theft losses (17).

sectors.trend: Brent at $100 on Middle East conflict. Data centre power demand strains NSW grid. Coal-to-data-centre pivot discussed.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Coal generators (IGO.AX, AGL.AX) face dual pressure: transition narrative vs. data centre demand. Energy security premium rising.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. Home buyer sentiment at multi-year low. NZ house crash echoes.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face rental yield pressure. Construction names hit by sentiment collapse. Residential REITs underperform; industrial/office selective.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX and healthcare remain defensive havens. Consumer staples resilient amid business conditions at pandemic lows.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer defensive allocation. Consumer discretionary under pressure from sentiment collapse.

sectors.trend: Austal $1.9b bid signals M&A activity. Data centre build-out creates infrastructure demand. AI theme global but limited ASX exposure.
sectors.implications: AUS.AX (Austal) event-driven upside. Data centre builders and electrical infrastructure names benefit. Limited pure-play ASX tech exposure.

key_themes: Oil shock at $100 driving inflation re-acceleration and RBA policy dilemma
Iron ore structural decline vs. gold/copper rotation in materials
Credit market stress (Bathla) and corporate distress (Qantas)
Housing bifurcation: luxury crash vs. affordable resilience
Energy security and data centre demand as structural tailwind
Geopolitical risk: Middle East conflict, China-Trump tensions
Business confidence at pandemic lows signalling cyclical trough

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation re-acceleration forcing RBA to hike or hold restrictive
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; hold quality bonds

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse from China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and copper (STO.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private credit and corporate credit stress contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank NPL exposure; avoid leveraged credit funds; monitor ASX small-cap liquidity

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing sentiment collapse spilling into construction and financials
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to residential REITs and construction; favour industrial/infrastructure REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Middle East, China-US) disrupting supply chains
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain 10-15% cash; hold gold as hedge; diversify away from China-revenue-heavy miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW/energy grid strain from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL.AX, IGO.AX, and grid infrastructure names; watch for policy intervention

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper miners as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: WA gold discoveries and copper strength provide relative outperformance; gold hedges geopolitical and inflation risk
Brent at $100 supports upstream margins; Middle East conflict sustains premium
$1.9b bid creates immediate re-rating; shipbuilding sector tailwind from defence spending

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Business conditions at pandemic lows; defensive sectors outperform in risk-off

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural demand decline from China; 'drowning not waving' signals multi-year headwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA 'choosing recession' plus sentiment collapse pressures valuations; luxury segment already correcting

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash and gold allocation as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Middle East conflict, China-US tensions, and credit stress create tail risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor big four banks for NIM compression and credit losses
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-hike environment plus private credit stress could pressure earnings

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Oil at $100 keeps inflation sticky, constraining RBA easing. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Expect volatility around Middle East headlines and RBA communications. Gold and energy outperform; banks and property lag. Sentiment fragile with business conditions at pandemic lows.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA pivots. Gold/copper rotation in materials continues. Data centre build-out supports energy and infrastructure names. Housing bifurcation persists. Key risk: prolonged geopolitical conflict or China demand collapse. ASX 200 likely range-bound 8,200-9,200 before any sustained recovery.
